name: SpaceX Daily
tagline: Follow SpaceX as a public company — launches, Starlink, Starship, and the SPCX market picture, every day.
description: The daily companion for following SpaceX as a public company (Nasdaq: SPCX). Launched the day of the largest IPO in history: Starship development, Falcon launch cadence, Starlink, Dragon missions, the SPCX market picture, and the engineering and economics behind the push to make life multiplanetary. The day's developments with sources, what the spaceflight community is buzzing about, one honest counterpoint, and a daily engineering deep dive. Not financial advice.

episodes.title: Ep 1: SpaceX’s record $75 billion IPO at $135 per share hands public investors quarterly numbers and disclosure in exchange for funding Starship, Starlink expansion, and AI infrastructure under Elon Musk’s controlling vote.
